logical_contradictions.description: Any direct contradiction on the same market with opposite directions triggers immediate FAIL.

high_correlation_without_coherence.description: HIGH correlation risk (e.g. player prop + same-match O/U total) without strong scenario coherence score >= 0.8 is demoted or failed.

unsupported_multiplication.description: Multiplying leg odds directly to compute combined Bet Builder odds is strictly forbidden.

fabricated_combined_odds.description: Never compute or suggest simulated combined Bet Builder odds. Combined odds must come directly from real bookmaker quotes.
